original_title: ‘Resident Evil’ Reboots at No. 1 as ‘Shaun the Sheep’ Bounds to No. 3 at U.K., Ireland Box Office
summary_en: The highly anticipated Resident Evil reboot has clawed its way to the top of the U.K. and Ireland box office, kicking off its run with a formidable £4.2 million. Meanwhile, the charming stop-motion adventure Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom secured a respectable third place, proving the enduring appeal of beloved franchises.
ai_analysis: This box office performance signals a strong appetite for both established horror IPs and family-friendly animation, with the Resident Evil reboot aiming to recapture the magic of its game origins and challenge previous franchise records.

en.title: Resident Evil Reboot Dominates UK Box Office, Shaun the Sheep Charms Audiences

en.body:
The Raccoon City outbreak has officially landed with a bang at the U.K. and Ireland box office, as Sony's new **Resident Evil** reboot stormed to the number one spot. Earning an impressive £4.2 million during its opening weekend, this latest iteration of the survival horror saga is off to a roaring start, surpassing the initial takings of previous franchise entries and setting its sights on higher total gross figures. It's a significant debut that immediately positions the film as a major player in the current cinematic landscape.

This strong opening places the **Resident Evil** reboot ahead of **Practical Magic 2**, which dropped to second place in its sophomore weekend after a solid performance the week prior. The film's success also outpaced the £2.6 million opening of **Cregger's** Oscar-winning **Weapons** last year, a horror film that went on to achieve a notable £11.9 million total. With its strong start, the **Resident Evil** reboot is now aiming to surpass the £10 million mark and potentially challenge **Weapons’** total gross, indicating a renewed fan enthusiasm for the series on the big screen.

## A New Beginning for Raccoon City

Directed by **Zach Cregger**, known for his work on **Weapons**, and co-written with **Shay Hatten**, this reboot is the second attempt to bring the iconic Capcom video game franchise back to cinematic life. The film is set against a modern backdrop, paralleling the events of the 1998 game **Resident Evil 2**. Audiences are introduced to **Bryan** (played by **Austin Abrams**), a medical courier caught in the midst of a terrifying viral outbreak that transforms the citizens of Raccoon City into infected monsters. The film leans into the core elements that made the games a global phenomenon: suspense, survival, and grotesque creatures.

## Beyond the Bite: Fan Favorites and Family Fun

While the undead rise in Raccoon City, the beloved **Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom** also made a strong showing, debuting at third place in the U.K. and Ireland box office. This proves that even amidst the terror of viral outbreaks, there's always room for Aardman Animations' signature charm and humor. The continued success of **Shaun the Sheep** across multiple films highlights its broad appeal to families and fans of stop-motion animation worldwide. Its solid debut ensures that this charming farmyard escapade is resonating with audiences, offering a delightful counterpoint to the darker themes dominating the top of the charts.

## What's Next

The **Resident Evil** reboot is now looking to solidify its box office performance in the coming weeks, with eyes on reaching and potentially exceeding the total gross of previous franchise hits. Meanwhile, **Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom** will continue to delight audiences, offering a dose of lighthearted fun. Further box office results will be closely watched to gauge the long-term impact of these new releases.
